exposure: infection prevention care bundle (preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative care)
outcome: REEDA Scale scores (Redness, Oedema, Ecchymosis, Discharge, Approximation)
cohort: 60 full-term pregnant women who were candidates for cesarean section.
finding: The infection prevention care bundle was not found to be statistically effective in preventing post-cesarean surgical site infection compared to routine care.
